				$("#input-lascompany-nip").keypress(function (e) {

				$("#input-lascompany-nip").keyup(function (e) {
					if ( e.keyCode == 65 || e.keyCode == 46 || e.keyCode == 35 || e.keyCode == 8 ) {} else {
				    	if (String.fromCharCode(e.keyCode).match(/[^0-9]/g)) return false;
					}
				});
				$("#input-lascompany-nip").keydown(function (e) {

				function checkFirma(){
				  var selectedValue = $('input[name="customer_type"]:checked').val();
				  if (selectedValue == 1) {
				    $('.firma_fields').removeClass('d-none');
				  } else {
				    $('.firma_fields').addClass('d-none');
				  }
				}
				$(document).on('change', 'input[name="customer_type"]', function () {
				  checkFirma();
				});
				checkFirma();
